title: Prior augmentation under a frozen one-measurement protocol

rows.endpoint: Change in held-out repeat agreement (Fisher z)
rows.aggregation: Within-compound mean across mapped condition/held-support rows, then paired compound bootstrap; each seed reported separately
rows.qualification: Historical frozen 1R/all-dose protocol; shared row-matched foreign null cancels in the paired method difference. Only 121 compounds with usable null coverage are scored. Prior uses ECFP4, held-plate pretreatment CP-control median and six-dose encoding. Weight 0.10 is selected using validation MSE and frozen; this is not an automatically rejected or zero-weight prior. No pooled seed confidence interval is available.

rows.endpoint: Change in held-out repeat agreement (Fisher z)
rows.prior_strategy: Validation-selected fixed weight; not an adaptive gate
rows.bootstrap_resamples_evidence: Frozen one-to-one runner default --bootstrap-rounds=10000; launch script does not override it. Metrics payload does not itself store the resample count.
rows.aggregation: One fixed support/held pair per compound; paired compound bootstrap, separately for each training seed
rows.prior_weight_selection: Official validation one-to-one RSF; teacher/prior/gate checkpoints are training-internal
rows.qualification: Historical one-support-to-one-held-plate experiment. The prior uses molecule plus baseline only. Fixed-lambda prior augmentation is the P0 interface reused by the subsequent GE-residual evaluation. Shared reference null cancels in the paired Fisher-z contrast. Adaptive-gate contrasts are distinct and are not substituted. Eligibility and calibration criteria differ from cpg0004; do not pool datasets or assert a controlled dataset interaction.

pooling: Six seed-specific intervals: three per dataset. Do not average CI endpoints or invent a pooled CI. Dataset-specific calibration and eligibility differ, so this is side-by-side evidence of prior usefulness versus lack of consistent gain, not a controlled statistical BBBC047-versus-cpg0004 interaction.

resolved_source_gaps.interpretation: Resolved: original per-seed numerical artifacts are now available locally
resolved_source_gaps.reason: The root agent retrieved the three original seed metrics; this audit verified version, smoke=false, fixed-weight selection and common molecule counts against the exact contrast entries.
resolved_source_gaps.scope: This does not assert that the experiment was not run or that its effect was zero.
resolved_source_gaps.resolution: Rows S2-P4 to S2-P6 use fixed_minus_teacher; adaptive_minus_teacher is explicitly excluded.

selected_bbbc_method_rationale: Both cpg0004 and the formal BBBC047 P0 use a validation-selected fixed blend. BBBC047 evaluate_1r_ge_residual.py reads fixed_lambda.selected_on_validation_one_to_one_rsf; manuscript prior-augmentation statement does not require or identify the separate adaptive-gate variant.
